name: Make Your Own Magic: Oracle Deck
label: Hands-on workshop
address: 522 Second Street SE Suite D, Charlottesville, VA, 22902
description:
Often, the best kind of magic is the kind you make yourself.
 In this creative Make Your Own Magic workshop, you'll create something that reflects your imagination and gives your intuition a place to speak. We'll briefly discuss the difference between tarot and oracle cards, and how to work with oracle decks for inspiration, and insight. Then make you'll make your own 13 card deck.
 Using a mix of different mediums, in combination with words, and symbols, your cards will reflect your own imagination, and inner world, offering a deeper connection to the messages behind them. There's no wrong way to make an oracle card, and no need to be an artist to make something meaningful.
 At the end of the workshop, you'll have your own handmade 13-card deck to take home and use.
 Come curious, come creative, and see what your cards have to say.
